description: Move defimpl Enumerable,for:List/Map/Range out of list.fz/map.fz/range.fz into enumerable.fz, root-level beside defprotocol. Bodies are fully-qualified delegators (List.reduce, Map.count, Range.member?), so they relocate without namespace change. Signal: Enum.reduce([1,2,3],...) resolves with list.fz never scoped. Depends on T3.
title: Move RTL Enumerable impls into enumerable.fz at root level
